messages:
anya: Quick heads-up — MistralSil EAP starts Mon. NDA fully executed. Hardware ships Mon AM. We need a concise bench + telemetry gating plan before Tue EOD. Link: https://internal.redwood/partnerships/mistralsil-eap
brad: copying bench playbook notes. do we use perf harness v3 or v2? v3 has kv-cache telemetry which partners want.
carla: let's run v3 but lock seed and prompt set. also define noise/regression gates: 5% latency p95 increase = fail, >1% correctness drift = fail. cc @ops
sam-partner: thanks — from MistralSil side we'll ship firmware v1.0.2 and test images. telemetry allowed per NDA: basic perf + aggregate mem/counters only. no raw logs.
legal-bot: Confirmed telemetry scope is within NDA. No model weights or user PII to be shared. Partner needs data retention window = 30 days.
ops: shipping window on Mon is 9–11am PST. lab oncall will do rack-in and power verification. please add runbook entries: `rack-in`, `burn-in 2h`, `network test`.
brad: I'll put together a minimal bench script. Example run:
```bash
./bench_runner --model redwood-v2-small --seq 1024 --batch 8 --iters 50
```
carla: also want a micro-benchmark for KV-cache hit ratio. script:
```python
# pseudo
run_infer(prompt="prefix" * n)
measure(kv_hits)
```
anya: timeline: Mon AM ship, Mon PM sanity + burn-in, Tue AM full bench + telemetry collection, Tue EOD decision call. Invite: @carla @brad @ops @sam-partner @legal-bot
sam-partner: sounds good. we'll also include a short press embargo until we sign off joint announcement. pls include communications team if we greenlight.
carla: noted — comms on-ramps: add marketing@redwood to decision thread. Also need marketplace packaging checklist if we pass.
anya: updated runbook checklist here: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/mistralsil-eap-checklist :thumbsup:
ops: added to schedule; oncall pager will be assigned. I'll post the runbook snippet in #eng-runtime once it's live.
